Mechanical Wooden Kits, Automata, Magic Tricks & Puzzle Boxes
Original designs by Shasa Bolton

Discover mechanical wooden automata, puzzle boxes, and DIY kits designed to be built, explored, and enjoyed. Each contraption combines engineering, creativity, and hands-on play.

Available as kits or fully assembled, these creations are perfect for adults, hobbyists, and kids working with guidance — turning simple parts into fascinating moving machines.
